trace.question: In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
trace.evidence: Final result should return the Team.team_long_name; Scotland Premier League refers to League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'; away team refers to away_team_api_id; away team that won the most refers to MAX(SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0); 2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; won the most refers to MAX(COUNT(*));

attempts.sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2009/2010'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: Rangers won the most away matches in the Scottish Premier League during the 2010 season.
